_README: Manual bathymetry survey -> FWA waterbody links, for depth-map surveys the automatic tiers (T1 identifier / T3 name+watershed-code / T2 spatial overlap) cannot resolve: a blank or mismatched WSA identifier, a missing watershed code, or no survey polygon. Consumed by pipeline.matching.bathymetry_matcher.build_wbk_bathymetry_map after the automatic tiers. Match key is the normalised MAP_TITLE; 'waterbody_key' is the FWA WATERBODY_KEY the survey sheets attach to. 'pdfs' lists the exact sheet filenames (also used to pin specific sheets when a map name is shared by more than one survey). 'fwa_name' and 'reason' are documentation only. Set 'ignore': true with 'waterbody_key': null to record a survey that cannot be linked yet (it is tracked here but not attached); optional 'candidates' holds the possibilities to resolve it later.

Sinclair Lake (a.k.a. Long Lake) was flooded into the Nechako Reservoir (Kenney Dam). No standalone FWA 'Sinclair Lake' waterbody exists; the historic depth chart no longer reflects current reservoir conditions, so it is intentionally not linked. If ever needed, the reservoir waterbody is Ootsa Lake / Nechako Reservoir = 328994947.
